headline: Man City vs. Premier League: 115 financial charges explained
description: The sporting world is waiting for a resolution to the hearings on Man City's charges for allegedly breaching the Premier League's financial rules. Here's what we know, and what might come next.

headline: Man City refuse to deny guilty verdicts in Premier League 115 breaches case
description: Manchester City on Friday did not deny there has been a guilty verdict in the majority of charges of financial breaches in their legal case with the Premier League.

headline: Chelsea charged by FA over alleged discriminatory chanting
description: Chelsea have been charged by the Football Association after discriminatory chanting was reported during their Premier League game away at Fulham in August.

headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season

headline: United Strand fan: Ruben Amorim told me 'sorry about that'
description: The Manchester United fan who has vowed to cut his hair only when the club win five Premier League games in a row has received an apology from former boss Ruben Amorim.

headline: Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga demand FIFA reform amid Gianni Infantino re-election bid
description: The top leagues in England, Italy, Germany and Spain have issued a joint-statement demanding governance reform at FIFA, amid Gianni Infantino's bid to be re-elected as president in 2027.
